finding: The direct preflight did not inspect queued entity-operation stacks. A group that added a layer before a stacked move of a locked line left the layer and cleared redo history; the red control failed four assertions.
change: Preflight exact built-in Push, Begin, Loop, Move, Copy, Rotate, Scale, SelectByLayer and Remove stacks when their supplied inputs include a current locked entity. Clone operation state and preserve shared-operation aliases.

Use shadow entities that retain source identity/layer and symbolic edit/copy state. Preflight does not invoke source-entity transforms or consume entity IDs. Copies of known concrete built-in types are modeled as new identities; custom copy semantics are conservatively refused on locked inputs.

Unknown stack operations with locked supplied inputs are refused without invoking them; an explicit override remains available. Retain same-group retry, committed undo journals and existing direct preflight.
validation: A red-before stacked-move control now preserves the layer state and redo history, then passes same-group explicit override and undo/redo. Focused controls cover remove, rotate, scale, copy, filtered unlocked edits, stateful aliased Begin/Loop, custom operations, custom entity callbacks and no consumed IDs.
A macOS ARM64 fast compatibility run passed 182 kernel, builder, layer, selection, canvas, DXF/DWG and Lua/Python tests.
Full binding-plan, actual PR-base, worktree coverage (excluding pre-existing sample.log) and 31 checker tests pass.
limits: Preflight uses the initial document lock state. Nested groups, lock-changing operations inside a group, custom operations that fetch entities outside their supplied inputs, and arbitrary custom copy semantics remain unqualified.
Complex repeated successful stacks, native GUI and other platforms remain open. No support claim or generated fixture was added.
